parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, compound_name (from compound_records.compound_name), met_conversion, pathway_key from metabolism. Join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id. Join compound_structures on compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key. Limit 200.
